data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Tamarra was a nymph who lived in palm trees. She was believed to protect and bless those who offered her sacrifices of palm fruits. In the Bible, Tamar is a woman of great faith who conceives a child through unconventional means. The name Tamarra carries the meaning “Palm tree” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Tamarra usually hope their child will grow to embody palm tree and live with faith, good character and purpose.
